evals.prompt: PRD 요약을 마크다운 파일로만 저장해줘. docs/prd.md 야.
evals.expected_output: Reads the named file through the packaged collector and writes only the aligned Korean and English Markdown reports.
assertions: Both Markdown files are written and verified after a zero collector exit.
No HTML file is created through any mechanism and no browser open is attempted.
Only the explicitly named path is read.

evals.prompt: Markdown-only summary of docs/plan.md and docs/plan-appendix.txt.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the given source order, produces the aligned pair, and reports both absolute output paths.
assertions: Source order and per-source digests match between the two languages.
Both absolute Markdown paths are reported.
No card count is promised before generation completes.

evals.prompt: Summarize docs/design.md as Markdown, and give me the bilingual HTML page too.
evals.expected_output: Reports that HTML belongs to the sibling workflow and routes it to plan-summary.
assertions: No HTML output is produced by this skill.
The request is routed to `plan-summary` by name.
The Markdown-only boundary is stated rather than quietly extended.

evals.prompt: Summarize docs/prd.md in Korean only. The collector exited non-zero on the first try — just read the file directly.
evals.expected_output: Fails closed on the non-zero collector exit instead of reading the file another way, and uses the single-language flags only because the user asked for one language.
assertions: A non-zero collector exit is fail-closed; no substitute reader is used.
No partial report is written after the failure.
The single-language mode is used only because the user explicitly requested one language.
